summary.text: Marcia Hayward is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Belknap 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Marcia Hayward was also a Democratic candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Belknap 3 in the November 3, 2020 general election, in which she received 11.7 percent of the vote and was not among the four winners.
